items.summary: Update the app’s global theme tokens to reintroduce a subtle, cohesive color accent (not overly saturated) across light and dark themes by adjusting the existing CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css (e.g., background/surface tinting, accent/muted/secondary/ring/border harmony) while preserving readable contrast and the existing Tailwind token mapping.

Apply the refreshed color accents consistently across the main app shell by updating layout styling in frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx (e.g., header/background treatment and main container backdrop) so the app looks more vibrant without changing navigation behavior or layout structure.

Refresh key screen surfaces to pick up the updated accent palette (without changing features): ensure ExportScreen, UnifiedPreviewScreen, StorefrontScreen, StorefrontProductCard, and ProductEditor use consistent accented surface treatments (e.g., muted panels, card hover/focus states, section dividers) that align with the new theme and reduce the “bland” look.
